title: Cruel Choices
paragraphs: Ren, Itsuki, and I stepped forward and took our stances. Yes. I haven’t just been playing around until now. No matter what kind of enemy it is, I’ll defeat them. Then, I’ll be recognized by Father and Big Sister, and I’ll build true love with Filo-tan.
“I’ll take the role of referee.”
“What’s going on?”
Sakura-chan arrived with Fiancée, having heard the commotion.
“Um, a girl who seems to be Raphtalia from another world showed up, so we’re testing how strong she is. Just watch quietly.”
“Okay.”
Father explained the situation and gave the signal.
“Alright then… Ready… Begin!”
“Here I go—”
“First, I’ll—”
“I’m going in with full force—”
The Raph species’ big sister held the squeaky hammer in her right hand and snapped her fingers with her left.

…That was all. All I saw was her form slightly blur and then rapidly close the distance. Immediately after, the sound of successive blows echoed through our bodies. There was no pain, but the impact reverberated through us.
“W-What…!?”
“What was that!?”
“I couldn’t even see it!”
The Raph species’ big sister was already back in her original position, with the hammer returned to her waist.
“That was me holding back… to an extreme degree. What did you think?”
“Uh… huh?”
Father looked back and forth between us and the Raph species’ big sister. We couldn’t see a thing.
“This isn’t about strength anymore… That’s just unfair…”
“Yes. To put it in the terms you heroes like to use, this strength surpasses even cheats. This wasn’t even a contest. And I was still following the rules of this world.”
“How powerful is our enemy, then…? And if you can do all that, does that mean…?”
“Yes, to put it bluntly, we now have a way to defeat the enemy.”
The Raph species’ big sister nodded in response to Itsuki’s question.
“Let’s get back to the topic. About what it means that this world is still undecided.”
“Can we even beat a monster like that?”
“No, we can’t. The priority is to make sure it doesn’t get in. If it does, it’s over… but this world offers a remaining method.”
Rival nodded at the words of the Raph species’ big sister.
“Let me ask the Raphtalia who wields power equal to a god. Why did you come here?”
“Of course, I came to bring the Spear Hero to defeat the enemy that claims to be a god.”
“Oh! So that means I can return to the original world?”
“In the end, yes. However…”
Father and the others turned their gazes toward the Raph species’ big sister. …Hmm? Is there something else?
“What happens to us?”
The Raph species’ big sister remained silent. T-This is troubling… What will happen to Father and the others in this world?
“What do you mean it’s different from parallel timelines? Should I call you… Raphtalia?”
“That’s fine. I’ll also call Naofumi-sama the same way.”
There’s a certain distance between them. To be honest, Father and Big Sister used to be much closer than this.
“Naofumi-sama also makes that kind of gentle expression sometimes.”
“Uh… yeah. From what Motoyasu said, he’s been through a lot of hardships.”
“Yes… I’ll continue. The reason this world exists is solely for the extension of the world’s life. Time here passes far faster than in the original world.”
The Raph species’ big sister floated gently as she explained. She’s literally flying.
“To explain it in a way that’s easy for Naofumi-sama to understand, the branching of worlds doesn’t mean they completely separate… It’s like route branching in a game.”
“Then, doesn’t that mean parallel worlds are created?”
“No matter how many save files or branches there are, only one can be loaded… that’s what this world is.”

Understanding the meaning, Father widened his eyes and nodded. I also grasped the meaning and recalled that even in Demon Realm Earth, no matter how many save files you have, you can only play one. It’s probably the same concept. Only one is recognized. Essentially, the branched route overwrites the original save data. That must be the power of this spear.
“When I described this world as an unhatched egg, that’s what I meant.”
“What do you mean?”

“In a situation where the world is already cornered after being invaded by the false god, this world and the power of the Long Hand of the Dragon Clock—this spear’s power—serve as emergency measures to extend the world’s life. If successful, this world… can overwrite the original world and expel the false god.”
“Oh…”
“Then shouldn’t we just do that? The original world is already doomed, right?”
Hearing those words, the Raph species’ big sister placed her hand on her chest, clenched her fist, and nodded.

“Of course… now that I’ve seen the situation firsthand, I can say that’s one possible solution. Even if that condition… requires sacrificing two-thirds of the world’s life and all the worlds it merges with…”

Father and the others exchanged smiles at her agreement, but they were left speechless by the latter part. Two-thirds… that’s from the time before last. But what does she mean by the world it merges with?
“W-What do you mean…?”

“The condition to trigger the branching world. The creation of the barrier by the Four Spirits… that’s the purpose of the spear and the meaning behind the loops. The decision rests with the Spear Hero.”
Rival explained with a bitter expression. The Four Spirits’ barrier…
That happened two loops ago when we fought all four spirits.

“I have already stepped outside that loop… There will be no changes to Naofumi-san or me, and we’ll only have to fight the false god that was expelled. They might escape, but we will definitely pursue and defeat them. Then, this world will be safe.”
Her friend fell silent after hearing those words.
“Then… what happens if we go with the plan to bring Motoyasu-kun back?”

“The power of the Four Heroes will bind the false god, seal their illicit power, and pin them to the world so they can’t escape. We should be able to defeat them for sure… But… even without the Spear Hero, I think we can suppress them with our own hands. This is just a precaution.”
“But after defeating the false god… what happens to this world?”
“This world won’t continue to exist forever… I believe it will disappear after we defeat the false god.”
“Damn it… isn’t this just a deadlock?”
To keep this world alive would require tremendous sacrifices, but to save the original world, this world would have to be discarded.

“Protecting the happiness of those close to us, even if it means immense sacrifice… that’s also a choice… I think. Naofumi-sama, the Sword Hero, the Bow Hero, and the Spear Hero can survive in either world… and there are many people here in the village… In fact, more people are alive in this world.”
The Raph species’ big sister’s gaze was wavering. Her expression showed deep confusion.
“Considering the immense sacrifices already made in the original world, the difference might not be significant. I believe Naofumi-sama would understand. Therefore—”
At that moment, her friend placed her hand gently on the Raph species’ big sister’s cheek.

“…No, Raphtalia-chan. I know what you’re struggling with, what you’re doubting, and what you’re trying to entrust to others. But you can’t weigh this world and the original world on the same scale. This place… is like a dream world. You can’t treat a dream and reality the same.”
Father watched the scene in silence, lowering his gaze. A dream world… huh.
“…Ever since the heroes came to help us, I’ve had this feeling. That this was all too good to be true, like a miraculous time…”
Her friend turned her back to the Raph species’ big sister and began to speak. From the time Father saved her from the brink of death until now, she recounted everything that had happened.
“Every single moment was a miracle. I heard that it was all thanks to the Spear Hero. It was like a dream… But a dream is still a dream… Eventually, you have to wake up.”
“Rifana-chan… you…”
Her friend smiled gently.

“I understand that Raphtalia-chan is saying what’s most convenient for us. But if we sacrifice two-thirds of this world and the merged worlds, wouldn’t there be more people left alive in the world we wake up to after defeating the enemy?”
“…I’m sorry.”
